atms: 3,412 (end-Q2-2026), +6.8% y/y (+216 machines) - the highest y/y growth in the whole published NBS series (from Q1-2016), reversing a 2021-25 plateau; Q1-2026 was 3,336 (+3.6%)

cash_trend: Fewer, bigger withdrawals now stalling in value: withdrawal COUNT down every year since 2021 (35.68m -> 26.40m) while VALUE rose RSD 1,875bn -> 2,353bn; but H1-2026 withdrawal value is flat y/y (+0.4%) on -5.8% count. Deposit value is 1.40x withdrawal value (FY2025) and 1.47x in H1-2026 (provisional)
instant_payments: IPS NBS Q2-2026 34.46m txns (+30.7% y/y) worth RSD 442bn (+32.3%); July-2026 alone 11.31m txns / RSD 154.9bn, avg ticket RSD 13,694, ~1.0s execution; three banks hold ~64.4% of value. SEPA SCT fully operational since 05/05/2026 with 18 banks; NBS 2026 procurement plan carries 'Ukljucenje u SEPA (TIPS)' and a 'Target IPS' EU-connection software upgrade
implication: Rare CEE/SEE market ADDING ATMs (+6.8% y/y) while closing branches (-17% in five years) - recyclers/TCRs, kiosks and multivendor ATM software lead, with managed services and telemetry on a growing estate run by fewer staff; a POS estate at 195k adding ~17-18k devices a year needs TMS plus softPOS for the micro-merchant tail; the CReM 30/11/2026 retail deadline forces remote qualified e-signature and eKYC at every bank within three months; and the NBS HSM, cyber-protection and SEPA/TIPS procurement lines are direct hooks at the central bank itself

atms: 1,414 (end-Q2-2026, provisional) from 1,091 end-2025 (+29.6% in six months) and 1,011 end-2024 (+39.9% over 18 months - not a y/y rate, BoA publishes no Q2-2025); 458 deposit-capable, but ZERO customer machines are BoA-certified for fitness, so none may legally recycle lek
branches: 408 (end-2025) from 400 (end-2024), +8 units, second consecutive rise, 46% in Tirana, one unit per 5,792 residents; BoA data via Monitor 30/07/2026. The 405 (2024) / 385 (2023) figures are Albanian Association of Banks data - a different basis, do not chain
cash_trend: Money outside banks RISING on the BoA primary: 505,722m lek end-Jun-2026 vs 483,447m end-Dec-2025 (+4.6% in six months, +14.4% y/y). The press '546bn end-Jul-2026 vs 501bn Jan-2026' is a broader currency-in-circulation measure and does not match this series. Teller cash deposits 783.7bn lek in H1-2026 against only 68.6bn through the whole ATM estate - the counter absorbs 11.4x the ATM deposit value
instant_payments: TIPS Clone domestic instant payments, built with Banca d'Italia and World Bank support and confirmed by BoA primary (11th KKSP, Dec-2025) as a pillar of 'Cashless Albania'. That primary states go-live 'planned in July 2026'; Governor Sejko said on 05/08/2026 it should be fully operational in NOVEMBER 2026 - 30-second settlement, 24/7, inside bank mobile apps, addressable by phone number with payee verification. SEPA credit transfers live since 7 Oct 2025 (BoA accepted Nov-2024); AIPS-EURO carried 287,956 client euro payments worth EUR 4.34bn in Jan-Jul-2026 (+55% monthly count); AECH retail clearing +46% in seven months. AIPS, AIPS-EURO and AECH were all migrated to ISO 20022 during 2025
implication: Fastest-growing ATM (+29.6%) and POS (+23.7%) estate in the footprint in one half-year, an instant rail landing ~Nov-2026, and a branch counter still carrying 62% of transfer value and 783.7bn lek of cash deposits: NCR dispense/deposit plus x-core and managed services; Glory/Sesami TCRs where Printec is already the ONLY BoA-certified distributor of customer cash machines but no machine is fitness-certified, so putting one through BoA testing unlocks recycling; Verifone/Castles POS plus TMS and softPOS as BoA cuts card commissions; INETCO real-time monitoring, Verification-of-Payee and AML screening for the instant rail (ISO 20022 migration is already done, so sell controls and capacity, not message transformation); Namirial eKYC/e-signature off the eIDAS2 wallet law adopted 07/05/2026

atms: 1,868 (end-Dec-2025, CBBiH, pub. 11/03/2026), +5.7% y/y — but the mix reversed twice: dispense-only FELL to 1,281, deposit/recycling ('uplatno-isplatni') rose to 567 (+64% y/y, +222 units), and bill-payment ATMs were CUT from 128 to 20 (-84%)
branches: 749 bank organisational units (end-Dec-2025, CBBiH, pub. 30/03/2026) — flat vs 749 in 2024; FBiH 450 / RS 283 / Brcko District 16
cash_trend: Cash outside banks +8.56% y/y to 7.46bn KM at 31/12/2025 (tourism-driven, per CBBiH), and CBBiH notes bank VAULT cash stabilised and grew mildly in 2025 after falling through 2024 — yet the cash share of card turnover fell 68% to 65%; ATM withdrawals 13.59bn KM = 64% of the 21.10bn KM card total. More notes to handle, smaller share of spend.
instant_payments: IPS BiH (Banca d'Italia TIPS Clone, ECB-consented, EUR 2m EU-funded) went live 20/07/2026 with 3 banks, now 5 of 21 licensed banks (CBBiH separately counts 22 offering e-banking); 24/7/365, 5,000 KM cap, BAM-only, mobile/e-banking initiation MANDATORY; no volumes published yet. CBBiH roadmap: QR-code overlay then cross-border. SEPA application filed 06/08/2026 after both entities passed enabling laws (FBiH 28/07/2026); World Bank puts BiH fee savings at ~EUR 100m.
implication: A conversion market, not an expansion one: recyclers/TCRs and intelligent-deposit ATMs against 1,281 remaining dispense-only units, sold bank-by-bank off FBA's and ABRS's published device tables. SEPA plus IPS force ISO 20022 payment-hub, digital-channel and HSM work at the 16 non-live banks inside ~18 months, with a CBBiH-stated six-month post-admission clock. FATF grey-listing and the binding FBA IKT decision (in force since 31/12/2025, external ICT-audit filing due every 31 March) open AML, transaction-monitoring and cryptographic key-management lanes. Two things to avoid overselling: ATM bill payment is a lost battle, not whitespace — banks retired 108 payment ATMs in 2025; and fully-remote eKYC stays legally blocked until an e-identity/trust-services law passes, which the EC recorded as no-progress on 04/11/2025.

implication: POS estate +45% in one year (+9,400 terminals) with transaction counts still +47% y/y in Jun-2026: terminals, TMS and softPOS now. Branch estate built out and now frozen, so sell branch productivity — recyclers, intelligent-deposit ATMs and OptiCash — against a 33% unfit-note rate and rising ATM deposit flows. ISO 20022, overlay services and HSM/key-management work against the Nov-2026 TIPS Clone window; regulatory remediation against the statutory 11/02/2027 Law-on-Banks deadline and the already-effective 01/06/2026 cyber-risk regulation.

atms: 664 (Q1-2026); 751 at end-2025, +20.0% y/y — highest year-end in the 2018-2026 CBCG series (Q1 is below the preceding Q4 in every year of the series; the cause is not published). 126 of 664 cash-deposit-capable (+46.5% since end-2024, and no Q1 dip) — 538 machines without deposit capability
branches: — (no branch / organisational-unit count published by CBCG or any Montenegrin authority; negative re-confirmed this run by my own full-text extraction of Bilten 7-2026, which has no payment-infrastructure chapter at all, plus the publications index showing the 2025 Work Report still unpublished)
cash_trend: Falling: over-the-counter cash orders 5,478,745 in 2025 (-7.1% y/y, -19.5% since 2022) worth EUR 5.772bn (-4.7%); Q1-2026 -6.0% y/y on both count and value. Scope is branch/order-based cash on transaction accounts and EXCLUDES ATM cash. Business (legal-entity and entrepreneur) cash deposits still ~EUR 2.9bn/yr, 81% of all deposit value
instant_payments: IPS live 20/07/2026 (TIPS Clone, with Banca d'Italia under the ECB umbrella, financed by an EUR 8m World Bank credit); all 11 banks live simultaneously and Montenegro was the first country to put the TIPS Clone platform into operation. July-2026 first 12 days: 56,678 orders / EUR 21.53m, ~EUR 380 average ticket, full availability. Per-order cap EUR 3,000, covering almost 80% of all transactions; fee on sub-EUR-200 mobile/internet instant payments capped at 5 cents on both send and receive (previous average 32 cents), and above EUR 200 no more than the bank's ordinary transfer fee. Phase 2 = QR, mobile-phone-number alias, Request to Pay; SEPA Instant named as a next step, no date
implication: 5-cent fee cap plus CBCG's published 'just over 60% electronic' share of credit transfers makes cost-to-serve the whole story: deposit/recycling ATMs and TCRs against 538 non-deposit ATMs and ~EUR 2.9bn of annual business cash deposits, kiosks and cash-cycle optimisation for the seasonal coastal swing; real-time monitoring and fraud scoring for an irrevocable rail amid a CBCG-reported phishing wave; POS/TMS against +4,475 terminals in five quarters, with softPOS a competitive rather than greenfield pitch now that Hipotekarna fields ProvisionPay-powered MojPOS; digital-channel, open-banking-API and e-signature work against four incumbent bank apps rated below 2.5/5 and a licensed PISP/AISP (PrestoPay) out-charting every bank app in the national free chart

atms: 1,136 (Mar-2026, Q1-2026), +7.0% y/y vs 1,062 Mar-2025; 1,132 end-2025; 473 cash-deposit-capable (41.6%), +16.5% y/y. Caveat: total fleet flat at 1,132 through Dec-2025/Jan-2026/Feb-2026, +4 in the quarter — growth is now inside the fleet, not in unit count. [NBRSM Table 3, revised 25/06/2026]
branches: 371 (end-2025), -3.4% y/y and -9.3% vs 409 in 2020; fell in each of the last five annual observations. [NBRSM Table 3.2, published 27/03/2026; sum of 80 municipality rows — the file has no national total row]
cash_trend: Cash still dominant but moving into the machine: ATM withdrawal VALUE +11.8% y/y at Mar-2026 (MKD 19.27bn in the month) while ATM deposit VALUE +53.0% (MKD 3.65bn); deposits are now 19.0% of withdrawal value, up from 13.8% a year earlier and 15.9% at Dec-2025. Deposit COUNT +31.0% y/y vs withdrawal count +3.4%. More than 90% of purchases at small merchants are still paid in cash (NBRSM Vice-Governor, 18/06/2026). Absolute currency-in-circulation series not obtainable this run — do not derive one.
instant_payments: No domestic instant rail live — NBRSM Table 7's 'Instant payment' column reads zero in all 27 monthly rows from Jan-2024 to Mar-2026, on both the volume and value sheets. TIPS-clone (Banca d'Italia, under an ECB decision) accession EXPECTED in November 2026 alongside Albania and Kosovo, per ECB President Lagarde and NBRSM (24/07/2026) — NBRSM's word is 'expected', no day fixed. First MIPS test cycle passed in July 2026 with most messages on ISO 20022, inside an EU-financed capacity project (NBRSM, 04/08/2026). MIPS credit transfers Mar-2026: 656,970 worth MKD 1,008.4bn (~EUR 16.4bn); KIBS 2,217,260 worth MKD 58.8bn.
implication: Rare growth market, but the growth has changed shape: the ATM fleet added 91 units across 2025 and only 4 in Q1-2026, while deposit-capable machines rose 449 to 473 in that same quarter — so the opportunity is a deposit/recycler UPGRADE of the 663 remaining dispense-only ATMs plus branch transformation (kiosks, TCRs, accessible fit-out), not fleet expansion; Komercijalna banka has already run that template at five or more branches. Cash-in at 19% of cash-out value is the strongest recycler business case in the footprint. The expected November-2026 instant go-live drives ISO 20022 mapping, 24/7 channels, real-time fraud monitoring and HSM/key work (XL). Acceptance is concentrated at only ~16,700 merchants against ~36,000 devices, with the central bank publicly calling for cheap simple acceptance — a softPOS/TMS opening endorsed from the top. Tokenization +137.5% y/y against a shrinking credit-card count (-2.5%) makes card issuing, token provisioning and CNP fraud monitoring the digital-side lane.

atms: 15,768 (01/07/2026), +0.2% YTD — flat for three years and marginally BELOW end-2023 (15,801 at 01/01/2024; 15,714 at 01/01/2025; 15,733 at 01/01/2026). Only 2,785 (17.7%) are deposit-capable, and that share has not grown since 2024
branches: 4,754 operating structural units (01/07/2026), -38 q/q, -1.3% YTD, -5.1% vs 5,011 at 01/01/2025; plus 787 units temporarily suspended (Oschadbank 640, Raiffeisen 52)
cash_trend: Cash still rising fast: M0 UAH 921.8bn as at 01/08/2026 (+6.3% YTD after +14.1% in 2025). Cashless card payments are 96% of transactions by count but only 67% by value. A new 2000 UAH note enters circulation 04/09/2026
instant_payments: Ukraine HAS a live domestic instant-payments scheme: SEP-4.1 went live Dec-2024 with instant credit transfers, built on ISO 20022 and using the SEPA scheme explicitly to ease future EU integration; the law implementing EU Reg. 2024/886 took effect Nov-2024 and since AUGUST 2025 PSPs offering credit transfers are legally OBLIGED to offer instant credit transfers (10-second settlement, 24/7) initiated by the same remote channels, with QR-code/Deeplink details sharing. Not TIPS-connected. E-hryvnia CBDC: a pilot has already been run and an analytical note published, but no launch decision and no dated milestone
implication: Flat, largely non-deposit-capable ATM estate (2,785 of 15,768) plus rising cash volume plus a hard 04/09/2026 banknote deadline across 38,721 self-service devices = cash recyclers/TCR (Glory, Sesami, NCR intelligent deposit), cash forecasting/optimisation, and cassette/firmware retrofit with field services. The fastest-growing physical channel is PTKS kiosks, up 68% in 2025 to 22,953 — and every one of them also needs a Resolution-67 OTP screen flow pushed remotely via TMS. Acceptance growth of 13-19%/yr plus softPOS at 69,783 devices (+65% since Feb-2025) feeds POS/softPOS/TMS. July-2026 AML fines — notably UAH 16.1m on Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine for risk-scoring, CDD, PEP and technology-risk failures — plus a draft resolution that expressly permits OUTSOURCING the payment-monitoring function feed Siron/FICO/INETCO and managed monitoring services.
